newsitem.title: USA: VSE files two sale registrations.
newsitem.headline: VSE files two sale registrations.

text.p: VSE Corp said it has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission covering the potential sale of up to 200,000 shares of VSE common stock to meet employee benefit plan obligations.
The company said the 200,000 shares covered by this registration statement are outstanding VSE shares and are included in the 1,738,334 shares of VSE stock which are currently outstanding.
No new shares are being issued pursuant to this registration statement, the company said.
VSE said it has filed a separate registration statement covering up to 218,996 new shares of VSE stock which may be issued on exercise of option agreements under VSE's 1996 Stock Option Plan.
The company said the potential 218,996 new shares represented by this separate registration statement are not included in the 1,738,334 shares of VSE stock currently outstanding.
